decisions: Give me a technical summary of the DDPM paper. What is the core innovation and how does it perform?

requirements.description: Must explain the 'Reverse Process' as a Markov chain that uses Langevin dynamics to denoise samples, contrasting it with the forward diffusion process.
Must describe the visual progression of sample generation as shown in the 'Progressive Sampling' figures (e.g., Figure 6 or 10), noting how coarse features appear before fine details.
Must derive performance comparisons from the Results Table (Table 1), specifically comparing DDPM's FID scores (e.g. 3.17) against GAN baselines.
Must cover the 'Experiments' section, highlighting the trade-off between sample quality and log-likelihood scores compared to VAEs.
